title: Nasty Smoky Roasted Tomato Indulgent Crumble
description: An earthy, crumbly, indulgent Jamaican dish featuring vine tomatoes that are simmered and served as a gluten-free-friendly dessert.
instructions: Sauté minced garlic in olive oil until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Simmer for about 15 minutes or until the tomatoes are soft.
Stir in smoked paprika, apple cider vinegar, flour, and maple syrup/honey. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Fold in room-temperature butter chunks to create a crumbly mixture.
Press the mixture onto the bottom of a greased dish or pour it evenly into a baking dish.
Bake at 200°C for 30 minutes, then reduce heat to 175°C and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes or until golden brown and crisp on top.
Let cool slightly before serving as a dessert.
